question: The average score of 7 players was initially recorded as 55. However, it was later discovered that a score of 35 had been mistakenly read as 53. Determine the correct average score.(Rounded up to two decimal places)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Correct Average = Initial Average + (Correct Value − Incorrect Value) ÷ Total Players

Correct Average = 55 + (35 − 53) ÷ 7

Correct Average = 55 − (18 ÷ 7)

Correct Average = 55 − 2.57

Correct Average = 52.43

**∴ The correct answer is 52.43.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial average score of 7 players = 55

Incorrectly recorded score = 53

Correct score = 35

**Formula Used:**

Correct Sum = Initial Sum &mi
